candidates.spoken: The engine didn't explode from fire.
A fatigue crack had grown inside it.
It took only a fatigue crack in one fan blade.
Debris shattered a window, and one passenger was killed.
At cruising altitude, a jet's engine suddenly blew apart.
When it snapped, the engine's inlet broke up.
Fragments struck the fuselage and the window gave way.
Fan blades were then checked more often with ultrasound.
The captain still landed the jet safely in Philadelphia.
fan blade inspections were accelerated with ultrasound checks.
The cause was a single fan blade.
It started with fatigue crack in fan blade. It ended with cabin depressurizes.

When it snapped, the engine's inlet broke up. Fragments struck the fuselage and the window gave way. The captain still landed the jet safely in Philadelphia. Fan blades were then checked more often with ultrasound.
